findings.title: The control-only maintenance envelope still permits executable launcher and product-build mutations
findings.reproduction: At the reviewed commit, is_maintenance_product_path("dev.cmd") and is_maintenance_product_path("tools/core_sidecar_build.py") both return false. In the existing real-Git UiChangeGateTests fixture, perform an approved UI implementation and then call install_reviewed_maintenance with mixed_product_path set independently to each path. validate(root, base, head) returns ok=true with errors=[] for both mutations.
findings.requiredResolution: Close GOV-MAINT-0007-R02-F02 across the complete executable product/build/runtime surface. Prefer a fail-closed explicit maintenance-control allowlist, or derive a complete protected inventory that includes root launchers and product-producing tools outside apps, modules, packages, packaging, services, and workers. Require zero net semantic delta for dev.cmd, bootstrap.cmd, tools/core_sidecar_build.py, and any equivalent launch/build/package path, and add real-Git denial regressions for at least one root launcher and one product-build tool while preserving legitimate control-only maintenance.
